verses.gurmukhi: ਸੀਂਚਤ ਸਲਿਲ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਚੰਦਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਏਕੈ ਚੰਦਨ ਬਖਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: see(n)chat salil bahu baran banaasapatee cha(n)dhan subaas ekai cha(n)dhan bakhaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: By irrigation, several kinds of plants and vegetation can be grown but when they come in touch with sandalwood they are all called sandalwood (because they have the same fragrance).

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਬਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਉਤਪਤ ਹੁਇ ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਏਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਕੈ ਜਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: parabat bikhai utapat hui asaT dhaat paaras paras ekai ka(n)chan kai jaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: Eight metals are obtained from mountain but when each one of them are touched by philosopher-stone become gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਸ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਤਾਰਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਚਮਤਕਾਰ ਦਿਨ ਦਿਨਕਰ ਜੋਤਿ ਏਕੈ ਪਰਵਾਨੀਐ ॥
verses.translit_en: nis a(n)dhakaar taaraa ma(n)ddal chamatakaar dhin dhinakar jot ekai paravaaneeaai ||

en.bdb: In the darkness of the night, many stars shine but during the day, the light of one Sun alone is considered authentic.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਗਨ ਮੈ ਲੋਗਾਚਾਰ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਨਮਨ ਉਨਮਾਨੀਐ ॥੪੦॥
verses.translit_en: logan mai logaachaar gurmukh eka(n)kaar sabadh surat unaman unamaaneeaai ||40||

en.bdb: Similarly a Sikh who lives life according to the advice of his Guru becomes divine in all respects, even when he is living life as a worldly person. Due to the lodging of the divine word in his mind, he is known to be living in heavenly state. (40)
